commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "988b4c8589eff4fbbcb15dcecd80bb6c6c75267d"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-qa-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "988b4c8589eff4fbbcb15dcecd80bb6c6c75267d"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=988b4c8589eff4fbbcb15dcecd80bb6c6c75267d"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*SupervisedTurnBackendTest'
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*ChatRelayBackendTest'
echo "OUTGOING_QA_ROUTER_HOST_PASS=true"
# Read-only readiness; no install, call, pairing, disclosure, or device setting changes.
if bash scripts/local_agent/device_readiness.sh >/tmp/aicalls-outgoing-readiness-$$.txt 2>&1; then
  echo 'S22_READINESS_PASS=true'
else
  echo 'S22_READINESS_PASS=false'
fi
rm -f /tmp/aicalls-outgoing-readiness-$$.txt
echo "QA_SHA=988b4c8589eff4fbbcb15dcecd80bb6c6c75267d"
